entries.details: Daily checklist: Eizzat reviews new support requests; Adly assigns and monitors IT tasks; both monitor critical issues; Adly checks active-project progress and blockers; urgent vendor follow-up is handled only when required. Public holidays are skipped.

entries.title: Weekly IT Issues and Task Planning
entries.details: Every Monday: review unresolved IT issues, prioritise important cases, and plan and assign the week's IT tasks.

entries.title: Midweek Project and NAS Review
entries.details: Every Wednesday: Adly reviews project progress and blockers; Eizzat checks important NAS storage status and reports capacity or health concerns.

entries.title: Weekly Network Review and IT Progress Update
entries.details: Every Friday: review major network or recurring IT issues and prepare the weekly IT progress update.

entries.title: Monthly IT Operations and Security Review
entries.details: Review IT support trends, IPServerOne email requirements, and TrendMicro security status.

entries.title: Monthly NAS, Microsoft 365 and Subscription Review
entries.details: Review NAS capacity and health, Microsoft 365 accounts and licences, and important software or service expiry dates.

entries.title: Monthly Equipment and Asset Review
entries.details: Review IT equipment and procurement requirements and ensure asset inventory changes are updated across all locations.

entries.title: Quarterly Preventive Maintenance Review

entries.title: Quarterly Hardware and Equipment Inspection
entries.details: Inspect desktop and laptop condition, printers and scanners, monitors, and other IT equipment.

entries.title: Quarterly NAS, Network and Recurring-Issue Review
entries.details: Inspect NAS health and storage, review network infrastructure, and analyse recurring IT problems.

entries.title: Yearly IT Asset and Replacement Review
entries.details: Review the full IT asset inventory and equipment replacement requirements for PCs, laptops, monitors, and other hardware.

entries.title: Yearly IT Budget and Subscription Review
entries.details: Prepare the yearly IT budget and review software subscriptions and renewals to prevent service interruption.

entries.title: Yearly IT Project Review and Roadmap

entries.title: Yearly Cybersecurity and Access Review
entries.details: Review cybersecurity controls, user access, accounts, permissions, and improvement priorities.
